entries.en: Added Claude Mods: plugins may now modify deeper behavior
entries.zh: 添加了克劳德模组：插件现在可以修改更深层次的行为

entries.en: Added You should know, a built-in mod where a side agent watches your back and flags things you or Claude might miss. Turn it on with `/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin` (for first-party sessions with telemetry on)
entries.zh: 添加了“你应该知道”，这是一个内置模组，其中有一个侧面代理监视您的背后并标记您或克劳德可能错过的事情。使用`/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin`将其打开（对于启用遥测功能的第一方会话）

entries.en: Added an `n:<text>` filter to the agents view that matches session names and tasks; a filter now shows matches in collapsed sections and Enter opens the first match
entries.zh: 在代理视图中添加了一个`n:<text>`过滤器来匹配会话名称和任务；现在，过滤器会显示折叠部分中的匹配项，然后按 Enter 键打开第一个匹配项

entries.en: Added `prompt_text` to the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event, a copy of `prompt` for backends that nest dotted keys; drop or mask it wherever you drop or mask `prompt` (anthropics/claude-code#70763)
entries.zh: 将`prompt_text`添加到 OpenTelemetry`user_prompt`事件中，这是嵌套点键后端的`prompt`的副本；无论您在何处删除或屏蔽“提示”，都将其删除或屏蔽（anthropics/claude-code#70763）

entries.en: Added URL prompts from MCP servers on the 2025-11-25 protocol, for example to sign in. If a server no longer connects after this update, add "bareElicitationCapability": true to its MCP config entry
entries.zh: 添加了来自 2025-11-25 协议的 MCP 服务器的 URL 提示，例如登录。如果服务器在此更新后不再连接，请将 "bareElicitationCapability": true 添加到其 MCP 配置条目

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Added a built-in `gh api` (REST only) for sessions that use Anthropic-managed git on macOS and Linux machines where the GitHub CLI is not installed
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：为使用 Anthropic 托管 git 且未安装 GitHub CLI 的 macOS 和 Linux 机器，新增内置的 `gh api`（仅 REST）

entries.en: [VSCode] Added "Run in background" to a running command or sub-agent, to move it to the background and keep working
entries.zh: [VSCode] 正在运行的命令或子智能体新增「Run in background」，可将其转到后台继续工作

entries.en: [VSCode] Added the output of background shells and Monitors to their cards in the agent map
entries.zh: [VSCode] 智能体地图中，后台 shell 和 Monitor 的输出显示在其卡片中

entries.en: Windows: Added a startup warning when denying the Bash tool also turns off the PowerShell tool, so Claude has no shell tool
entries.zh: Windows：拒绝 Bash 工具时若同时关闭了 PowerShell 工具，现在会给出启动警告，使 Claude 没有任何可用的 shell 工具

entries.en: Improved `/config`: settings that cycle show ‹ › and step both ways with ←/→, narrow terminals stack each value under its label, and PgUp/PgDn page the list
entries.zh: 改进 `/config`：可循环切换的设置显示 ‹ ›，用 ←/→ 双向切换；窄终端中每个值显示在标签下方；PgUp/PgDn 可翻页

entries.en: Improved plugin marketplace errors to say in plain words why a marketplace was ignored or refused, and what to do
entries.zh: 改进插件市场报错：用大白话说明市场为什么被忽略或拒绝，以及该怎么做

entries.en: Improved plugin listings to note when a plugin's dependencies were not installed, and updating a plugin now retries an install that did not finish
entries.zh: 改进插件列表：会提示插件的依赖未安装；更新插件时，未完成的安装会自动重试

entries.en: Improved the Claude apps gateway's error when Amazon Bedrock rejects a model ID: developers now see which model is unavailable, and the gateway log names the ID that was sent
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 应用网关：Amazon Bedrock 拒绝某个模型 ID 时，开发者能看到哪个模型不可用，网关日志会写出所发送的 ID

entries.en: Improved SDK sessions so a message sent with priority "now" no longer cancels a running web fetch or web search; it keeps loading in the background
entries.zh: 改进 SDK 会话：以优先级“now”发送的消息不再取消正在运行的网页抓取或搜索，而是转入后台继续加载

entries.en: Improved `/memory`: the left and right arrow keys now flip its on/off settings, such as Auto-memory
entries.zh: 改进 `/memory`：左右方向键可切换其中的开关设置（如自动记忆）

entries.en: Improved `/skill` names typed mid-message: Claude is now told they are skills, including `disable-model-invocation` ones
entries.zh: 改进 `/skill`：对话中间输入的技能名称，Claude 会知道它们是技能，包括 `disable-model-invocation` 类型的技能

entries.en: Improved the contrast of the prompt input border in light themes and of the ❯ before your earlier messages
entries.zh: 改进浅色主题下提示输入框边框的对比度，以及你之前消息前 ❯ 符号的对比度

entries.en: Improved delivery of files Claude sends from cloud sessions and Remote Control: an upload that fails on a timeout, a network error or a 502, 503 or 504 is now retried once
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 从云会话和远程控制发出的文件的投递：因超时、网络错误或 502、503、504 而失败的上传，会自动重试一次

entries.en: Improved what Claude says when a file cannot be sent for a reason that may be temporary: it now mentions that you can ask for the file again in a few minutes
entries.zh: 改进文件因可能是暂时性原因无法发送时，Claude 的回复：会提示你可以过几分钟再请求发送该文件

entries.en: Improved the prompt for a held message from another session to show the message between dashed lines, matching other permission prompts
entries.zh: 改进来自其他会话的待处理消息的提示：消息用虚线框起来，与其他权限提示保持一致

entries.en: Improved MCP and other tool permission prompts to show the tool call between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts
entries.zh: 改进 MCP 及其他工具的权限弹窗：工具调用用虚线框起来显示，与文件编辑弹窗保持一致

entries.en: Improved MCP startup in headless mode: a remote server whose first connect fails transiently is now retried without waiting for the slowest server to finish connecting
entries.zh: 改进无界面模式下的 MCP 启动：远程服务器首次连接临时失败时，直接重试，不必等最慢的服务器连接完成

entries.en: Improved files Claude sends from a remote session: large files now stream from disk instead of being read into memory, and a file over the size limit is refused with the server's limit named
entries.zh: 改进 Claude 从远程会话发送的文件：大文件改为从磁盘流式传输，不再整个读入内存；超过大小限制的文件会被拒绝，并注明服务器的限制

entries.en: Improved the explanation Claude gives when the server refuses a file it sends from a Remote Control or cloud session, such as an oversized image
entries.zh: 改进服务器拒绝从远程控制或云端会话发来的文件（如超大图片）时，Claude 给出的解释

entries.en: Improved handling of large MCP tool results: less memory, smaller session files, and no extra upload to count tokens for results far over the limit
entries.zh: 改进大型 MCP 工具结果的处理：占用内存更少，会话文件更小；远超限制的结果在统计 token 时无需额外上传

entries.en: Windows: Improved Bash tool speed by removing a subshell that ran before every command
entries.zh: Windows：移除了每条命令前运行的子 shell，提升了 Bash 工具的速度

entries.en: Changed a shell write through a repo-committed symlink onto a sensitive file or out of the working tree to name where it lands and wait for a person, on lines with a `~` target too
entries.zh: 更改了通过存储库提交的符号链接写入敏感文件或从工作树中写入的 shell，以命名它的着陆位置并等待一个人，也可以在带有`~`目标的行上进行

entries.en: Changed Opus 4.7+ and Fable to use a 1M context window by default on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and the Claude apps gateway, with no `[1m]` suffix (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` keeps 200K)
entries.zh: 将 Opus 4.7+ 和 Fable 更改为在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和 Claude 应用程序网关上默认使用 1M 上下文窗口，没有`[1m]`后缀（`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1`保留 200K）

entries.en: Changed replies from `claude agents` to arrive as queued messages; slash commands other than `/stop` sent while a turn is running now run when it ends
entries.zh: 更改了“克劳德代理”的回复以排队消息的形式到达；在回合运行时发送除`/stop`之外的斜杠命令现在在回合结束时运行

entries.en: Changed whole-tool `Bash` allow rules and allowing hooks to prompt for, not run, shell writes to files Claude Code's file tools refuse outright (the Anthropic profile store, the host credentials file)
entries.zh: 更改了整个工具`Bash`允许规则，并允许挂钩提示（而不是运行）shell 写入文件 Claude Code 的文件工具完全拒绝（Anthropic 配置文件存储、主机凭据文件）

entries.en: Changed right-click paste on Windows and Linux, and middle-click paste on Linux, to happen when the button is released; moving the pointer away before releasing cancels it
entries.zh: 更改了 Windows 和 Linux 上的右键单击粘贴以及 Linux 上的中键单击粘贴，以在释放按钮时发生；在释放之前将指针移开会取消它

entries.en: Changed MCP server `alwaysLoad: false` to defer all of that server's tools behind tool search
entries.zh: 更改了 MCP 服务器`alwaysLoad: false`以推迟工具搜索后面的所有该服务器工具

entries.en: Changed screen reader mode to write new or changed lines without first pausing with the cursor at the start of the line; set `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` to restore the pause
entries.zh: 更改了屏幕阅读器模式以写入新的或更改的行，而无需先将光标暂停在行的开头；设置 `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` 以恢复暂停

entries.en: Changed automatic model switches after a flagged message to keep your current effort level instead of the new model's default
entries.zh: 更改了标记消息后的自动模型切换，以保持当前的工作水平而不是新模型的默认值

entries.en: Changed waiting permission prompts to show oldest first, so a new prompt no longer covers the one you're reading (prompts with a countdown still open on top)
entries.zh: 将等待权限提示更改为首先显示最旧的提示，因此新提示不再覆盖您正在阅读的提示（顶部仍打开倒计时提示）

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: a failed marketplace add, remove or refresh now says what went wrong
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进 Manage plugins 对话框：添加、删除或刷新市场失败时，会说明具体原因

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the Claude in Chrome "Enabled by default" switch to also connect the editor's own sessions, which still ask before browser actions
entries.zh: [VSCode] Claude in Chrome 的「Enabled by default」开关现在也会连接编辑器自己的会话，这些会话在浏览器操作前仍会询问

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's task list in long Slack threads: background work no longer reposts it as a new message on its own, so people following the thread aren't notified
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进长 Slack 话题中的 Claude 任务清单：后台工作不再自行把清单作为新消息重新发布，因此关注该话题的人不会被通知

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved the failed-review card on a pull request whose conversation is locked: it now says the lock blocked the review and that nothing was posted or charged
entries.zh: [Code Review] 改进对话已锁定的拉取请求上失败审查的卡片：现在会说明是锁定阻止了审查，且没有发布任何内容，也没有收费

entries.en: Fixed fast mode staying off in remote sessions owned by an agent with no user account, even when the organization allows it
entries.zh: 修复了快速模式在没有用户帐户的代理拥有的远程会话中保持关闭的问题，即使组织允许

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control not receiving messages for minutes at a time when a reconnect request got no response; it now gives up after 30 seconds and retries
entries.zh: 修复了重新连接请求未得到响应时远程控制有时无法接收消息的问题；现在它会在 30 秒后放弃并重试

entries.en: Fixed hooks configured with `asyncRewake` waking Claude over and over with "found issues" notifications when the hook's script file is missing; the broken hook is now reported once
entries.zh: 修复了配置了`asyncRewake`的钩子，当钩子的脚本文件丢失时，会一遍又一遍地用“发现问题”通知唤醒克劳德；现在报告一次损坏的钩子

entries.en: Fixed tool heartbeats not reaching SDK hosts while the model's response stream was stalled with no data arriving
entries.zh: 修复模型响应流停滞、长时间没有数据到达时，工具心跳无法送达 SDK 宿主的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock and Vertex startup model checks ignoring an enforced `availableModels` list, which could collapse `/model` to one Opus row
entries.zh: 修复了 Bedrock 和 Vertex 启动模型检查忽略强制执行的`availableModels`列表，该列表可能会将`/model`折叠到一个 Opus 行

entries.en: Fixed the Claude in Chrome browser picker showing a JSON parse error when Chrome could not be reached
entries.zh: 修复 Claude in Chrome 浏览器选择器在无法连接 Chrome 时显示 JSON 解析错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed picking Fable in `/model` on a claude.ai login saving the current version's id, so your saved default now follows the newest Fable like Opus and Sonnet do
entries.zh: 修复了在 claude.ai 登录时在`/model`中选择《寓言》的问题，保存当前版本的 ID，因此您保存的默认值现在遵循最新的《寓言》，就像 Opus 和 Sonnet 一样

entries.en: Fixed switching between Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 (`/model`, `opusplan`) rewriting earlier MCP tool announcements, which could drop earlier extended thinking
entries.zh: 修复了 Opus 5.5 和 Sonnet 5.5（`/model`、`opusplan`）之间的切换，重写了早期的 MCP 工具公告，这可能会放弃早期的扩展思维

entries.en: Fixed Amazon Bedrock Guardrails blocks that arrive mid-response ending the turn with an API error instead of the guardrail's message when the reply began with thinking
entries.zh: 修复了在响应中途到达的 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 块，当回复开始思考时，会以 API 错误结束回合，而不是护栏消息

entries.en: Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) losing its always-ask safeguard when the same command also redirected output to a `~` or wildcard path
entries.zh: 修复了当同一命令还将输出重定向到`~`或通配符路径时，危险的`rm`（例如`/`或主目录上的`rm`）失去其始终询问保护的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` and SDK sessions repeating a model fallback on every later message after the model was switched while a reply was running
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`和 SDK 会话在回复运行时切换模型后对每条后续消息重复模型回退的问题

entries.en: Fixed a folder's CLAUDE.md being attached a second time after resuming a session or after a compaction
entries.zh: 修复了恢复会话或压缩后第二次附加文件夹的 CLAUDE.md

entries.en: Fixed background sessions that could not be reopened from `claude agents` after the agent exited and removed the worktree the session was started in
entries.zh: 修复了代理退出并删除会话启动所在的工作树后无法从“claude Agents”重新打开的后台会话

entries.en: Fixed `/advisor` pairing checks: Sonnet 5.5 can now advise Opus 4.7 and 4.8, and advisors the API would refuse are flagged up front instead of being silently dropped
entries.zh: 修复了`/advisor`配对检查：Sonnet 5.5 现在可以为 Opus 4.7 和 4.8 提供建议，并且 API 将拒绝的顾问会预先标记，而不是默默地删除

entries.en: Fixed Bash permission prompts showing internal parser names such as "Contains simple_expansion" instead of a plain explanation
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 权限提示，显示内部解析器名称，例如“Contains simple_expansion”，而不是简单的解释

entries.en: Fixed a cause of fullscreen sessions on slow or busy machines exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" while a scroll key was held in a long conversation
entries.zh: 修复了在长时间对话中按住滚动键时，缓慢或繁忙的计算机上的全屏会话退出并显示“无法恢复的界面错误后克劳德代码退出”的原因

entries.en: Fixed organization per-tool permission ceilings being silently dropped for an MCP tool named `__proto__`
entries.zh: 修复了名为`__proto__`的 MCP 工具悄悄降低组织每个工具权限上限的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude being told to page large MCP results saved as JSON with Read's offset and limit, which cannot split one long line
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 被告知将大型 MCP 结果分页保存为 JSON 并带有读取偏移量和限制的问题，该结果无法分割一长行

entries.en: Fixed the commit attribution reminder being delivered inside a tool result after a compaction
entries.zh: 修复压缩之后，提交署名提醒被放进工具结果中投递的问题

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode leaving the cursor away from the typed text in search boxes (such as /resume and /permissions) and sign-in code fields
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式，使光标远离搜索框（例如 /resume 和 /permissions）和登录代码字段中键入的文本

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode refusing Enter with nothing typed on /rewind's summarize options, whose added context is optional
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式拒绝在 /rewind 的摘要选项上输入任何内容的情况下回车的问题，其添加的上下文是可选的

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode showing a "Tab to amend" hint on approval prompts, where Tab does nothing
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式，在批准提示中显示“Tab 进行修改”提示，其中 Tab 不执行任何操作

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode listing arrow keys that do nothing in /permissions and /mcp, and saying "Select with numbers" in empty menus or while a search box has the keys
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式列出在 /permissions 和 /mcp 中不执行任何操作的箭头键，并在空菜单中或搜索框有这些键时显示“使用数字选择”的问题

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode leaving out the changed lines in file edit approval prompts and other diffs
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式忽略文件编辑批准提示和其他差异中已更改的行

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode sending the `claude --teleport` progress screen, and an MCP form field while it is being checked, to the screen reader again on every spinner frame
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式在每个旋转帧上再次向屏幕阅读器发送`claude --teleport`进度屏幕和检查时的 MCP 表单字段的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not removing the structured-output format from session-title and prompt-hook requests, which Bedrock-backed gateways reject
entries.zh: 修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS`未从会话标题和提示挂钩请求中删除结构化输出格式，而基岩支持的网关会拒绝该格式

entries.en: Fixed screen reader mode leaving out the top lines of a second approval prompt, a changed /config row or the rejected-plan line when the previous screen was taller than the terminal window
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式，当前一个屏幕比终端窗口高时，会遗漏第二个批准提示的顶行、更改的 /config 行或拒绝计划行

entries.en: Fixed `--include-partial-messages` sending a cut-short reply's `message_stop` late or never, so apps could show the reply as still in progress
entries.zh: 修复了`--include-partial-messages`发送简短回复的`message_stop`迟到或不发送的问题，以便应用程序可以将回复显示为仍在进行中

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents` sometimes not showing the permission prompt a background session is waiting on
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents”有时不显示后台会话正在等待的权限提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` giving advice about `.git/info/attributes` when the upload stops on a committed `.gitattributes` it cannot read, such as one saved as UTF-16
entries.zh: 修复了当上传停止在无法读取的已提交`.gitattributes`（例如保存为 UTF-16 的文件）时，`/ultrareview`提供有关`.git/info/attributes`的建议

entries.en: Fixed `claude remote-control` failing to register behind an HTTP proxy with a misleading "Check your organization permissions" error (anthropics/claude-code#97352)
entries.zh: 修复了 `claude Remote-control` 无法在 HTTP 代理后面注册并出现误导性的“检查您的组织权限”错误的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#97352)

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on Linux inheriting an open handle on the Claude Code executable
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上的沙盒 Bash 命令继承了 Claude Code 可执行文件上的开放句柄

entries.en: Fixed the running-tool dot and three spinners still moving with the "Reduce motion" setting on, and /rewind's confirm screen updating its "ago" time while you type a note
entries.zh: 修复开启"减少动态效果"后，运行中工具的圆点和三个旋转指示器仍在移动，以及 /rewind 确认界面在你输入备注时仍更新"几分钟前"时间的问题

entries.en: Fixed times in `claude agents` changing every second in screen reader mode; they now change at most every 10 seconds
entries.zh: 修复屏幕阅读器模式下 `claude agents` 中的时间每秒都变化的问题；现在最多每 10 秒变化一次

entries.en: Fixed a revoked claude.ai login showing a generic `API Error: 401` instead of "OAuth token revoked"; in `-p` mode the error now starts with "Failed to authenticate"
entries.zh: 修复了已撤销的 claude.ai 登录显示通用“API 错误：401”而不是“OAuth 令牌已撤销”的问题；在`-p`模式下，错误现在以“无法验证”开头

entries.en: Fixed `/ultrareview` upload refusals advising you to copy a variable named by a repository's settings file into your own user settings
entries.zh: 修复了`/ultrareview`上传拒绝建议您将存储库设置文件命名的变量复制到您自己的用户设置中的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--output-format stream-json` and the SDK not streaming the turns of a `context: fork` skill run by typing `/<skill>` as the prompt, as they do for the Skill tool's fork
entries.zh: 修复了`--output-format stream-json`和 SDK 不通过输入`/<skill>`作为提示来流式传输`context: fork`技能运行的问题，就像技能工具的 fork 一样

entries.en: Fixed /feedback and /bug: the pre-filled GitHub issue no longer includes your recent error messages, and the confirmation screen now lists them as part of the report
entries.zh: 修复了 /feedback 和 /bug：预填的 GitHub 问题不再包含您最近的错误消息，确认屏幕现在将它们列为报告的一部分

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add --sparse` and `git-subdir` plugin installs failing with "transport 'http' not allowed" when the repository is served over plain http
entries.zh: 修复了当存储库通过纯 http 提供服务时，“claude 插件市场添加 --sparse” 和`git-subdir` 插件安装失败并显示“不允许传输‘http’”的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions sometimes losing the earlier conversation when the session restarted while it was being compacted
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在压缩期间重新启动时有时会丢失早期对话的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin reload that overlapped the startup `--plugin-url` download corrupting the session's cached copy of the plugin archive
entries.zh: 修复了与启动`--plugin-url`下载重叠的插件重新加载，损坏了会话的插件存档的缓存副本

entries.en: Fixed `/desktop` quoting partial output when opening Claude Desktop timed out or printed too much output; the error now names the cause
entries.zh: 修复了打开 Claude Desktop 时`/desktop`引用部分输出超时或打印过多输出的问题；现在错误列出了原因

entries.en: Fixed an MCP connector tool call occasionally running twice, or the connector's calls failing until restart, when its server changed which MCP protocol version it supports
entries.zh: 修复了当其服务器更改其支持的 MCP 协议版本时，MCP 连接器工具调用偶尔会运行两次，或者连接器的调用在重新启动之前失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed SessionStart hooks from synced plugins not running in new cloud sessions
entries.zh: 修复了未在新云会话中运行的同步插件的 SessionStart 挂钩

entries.en: Fixed the transcript's "N hooks ran" summary and the verbose debug log's matched-hooks count including Claude Code's internal callbacks, so one configured hook no longer shows as two
entries.zh: 修复转录的"N hooks ran"摘要和详细调试日志中的匹配钩子计数，把 Claude Code 的内部回调也算进去，导致一个已配置的钩子显示为两个的问题

entries.en: Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing when the upload finished just after the 30-second timeout; it now waits 35 seconds
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德从云端发送的文件和远程控制会话在 30 秒超时后上传完成时失败的问题；现在等待 35 秒

entries.en: Fixed repositories added mid-session in cloud and SDK sessions not loading their skills and plugins, and loading CLAUDE.md late, after Claude changed directory
entries.zh: 修复了在云和 SDK 会话中添加的存储库未加载其技能和插件，以及在 Claude 更改目录后较晚加载 CLAUDE.md 的问题

entries.en: Fixed PNG, JPEG and WebP images over 8,000 pixels on a side failing to send from a remote session; Claude now sends a scaled-down copy
entries.zh: 修复了单边超过 8,000 像素的 PNG、JPEG 和 WebP 图像无法从远程会话发送的问题；克劳德现在发送缩小版副本

entries.en: Fixed messages sent from the Claude apps with 17 to 20 attached files delivering only the first 16
entries.zh: 修复了从 Claude 应用程序发送的包含 17 到 20 个附加文件的消息，仅传送前 16 个文件

entries.en: Fixed headless sessions reporting an MCP server as needing authentication after one refused call, even though later calls succeed
entries.zh: 修复了无头会话在一次拒绝呼叫后报告 MCP 服务器需要身份验证的问题，即使后来的呼叫成功

entries.en: macOS: Fixed Remote Control sessions started with `claude remote-control` stopping mid-turn when the Mac went to idle sleep
entries.zh: macOS：修复了用 `claude remote-control` 启动的 Remote Control 会话，在 Mac 进入空闲休眠时会在轮次中途停止的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed interactive `claude` hanging or crashing with "Raw mode is not supported" when its input is piped or redirected; it now says why and exits (use `-p` for piped input)
entries.zh: Windows：修复了输入通过管道或重定向时，交互式 `claude` 挂起或报 "Raw mode is not supported" 而崩溃的问题；现在会说明原因并退出（管道输入请使用 `-p`）

entries.en: Bedrock, Vertex, Mantle: Fixed model availability checks under `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH` sending a different `Authorization` header than real requests when `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` repeats it
entries.zh: 基岩、顶点、地幔：修复了`CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH`下的模型可用性检查，当`ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS`重复时，发送与实际请求不同的`Authorization`标头

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs blaming a timeout when Claude Code's reply was too large to confirm a save
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 Claude Code 的回复过大、无法确认保存结果时，设置对话框错误地归咎于超时的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed reopening a cloud session that the side bar already brought to this machine opening it again in a new tab; the side bar is shown instead
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新打开一个侧边栏已将其带到本机的云端会话时，会在新标签页中再次打开的问题；现在改为显示侧边栏

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the side bar's Web tab not listing cloud sessions started after the window loaded; a failed load now says "Remote server is not connected" instead of "No web sessions yet"
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复侧边栏的 Web 标签页不显示窗口加载后启动的云端会话的问题；加载失败时现在显示 "Remote server is not connected"，而不是 "No web sessions yet"

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a tab restored after a reload starting a second Claude process on a conversation the side bar already has open; it now shows the "still open somewhere else" notice
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复重新加载后恢复的标签页，会在侧边栏已打开的对话上再启动一个 Claude 进程的问题；现在会显示 "still open somewhere else" 提示

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed tool-row file links, session-list links and two hints showing in plain text
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复工具行中的文件链接、会话列表中的链接以及两处提示以纯文本显示的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a background agent's still-running command showing as failed once the main turn ended
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复主轮次结束后，后台 agent 仍在运行的命令显示为失败的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/usage` or `/context` command opening the extension's dialog instead of running when picked from the command menu
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复你自己的 `/usage` 或 `/context` 命令在从命令菜单选中时，打开的是扩展对话框而不是正常执行的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed file links in the plan preview tab doing nothing when clicked; they now open the file like links in chat replies
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复计划预览标签页中的文件链接点击无反应的问题；现在与聊天回复中的链接一样，会打开文件

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed opening a tool's input or output in an editor tab failing with "Timeout waiting after 1000ms" on remote hosts such as WSL when the tab is slow to appear
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复在 WSL 等远程主机上，标签页出现较慢时，在编辑器标签页中打开工具的输入或输出会报 "Timeout waiting after 1000ms" 的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed occasional failures to fetch from or push to GitHub when GitHub briefly refused a newly issued access token
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复 GitHub 短暂拒绝新签发的访问令牌时，从 GitHub 拉取或推送偶尔失败的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude posting a failure warning, such as a spend limit notice, in a Slack thread when a background event like GitHub activity woke it and nobody was waiting on a reply
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 GitHub 活动等后台事件唤醒 Claude，且没有人在等待回复时，它仍在 Slack 话题中发出失败警告（如花费限额通知）的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings leaving out recently created and private channels in organizations with many channels
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复在频道很多的组织中，Claude Tag 管理设置的花费限额页面漏掉最近创建的频道和私密频道的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed finding comments and their "Why this was flagged" text stopping mid-sentence; they now end on a complete sentence
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复问题评论及其「Why this was flagged」文字在句子中间中断的问题；现在会以完整句子结束

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review skipping a pull request after a new push when its review had failed twice on the previous commit; it now reviews the latest commit
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复新推送后，若上一提交的审查已失败两次，Code Review 会跳过该拉取请求的问题；现在会审查最新提交
